title.text: What shape does each question have?

runs.text: Each question is answered by walking through a collection of kiosk data. Place each one in the way of solving it that fits.
Counting and gathering give a number; searching gives an answer and stops as soon as it finds it; filtering and transforming give another collection: shorter the first, the same length the second.
Show each mark on the list.
How many days did it rain?
How much was sold in total?
Was there any day above 35 degrees?
The list of the pupils who passed.
All the prices with a 10 % rise.
